settings.top_line: A gift worthy of the relationships you've built.
settings.body:
Whether you are gifting to a team, a client, a collaborator or a retreat guest, we will help you create something that feels thoughtful, considered and beautifully aligned with the values you want to express.

We draw from our carefully curated collection of wellness, beauty, homewares, ceramics and objects for daily living, with a strong focus on sustainability, craftsmanship and women-led brands. We offer both curated and bespoke options and can work to create gifts tailored to your audience, occasion and budget.

Each gift is beautifully packaged using recyclable materials and can include handwritten notes or personalised messaging.
